correctness.rationale: Independent rerun of inputs/artifacts/verify_Fstar.py (sympy only) prints VERIFY_OK: catalecticant ranks 1/6/7/6/1 give H=(1,6,7,6,1); symbolic Hessian det expands to 0; L*=sum gives rank-6 maps A1->A2 and A2->A3 with minors 2 and 4; Koszul-Tor Betti rows match claimed table with Euler identity holding for all t=0..10. Independently confirmed: Hessian rows for x0,x1,x2 are [3u^2,0],[0,3v^2],[3(u+v)^2,3(u+v)^2] in (u,v)-columns only, so 3 rows in 2-dim coordinate subspace force det=0; extra run confirms outer maps have maximal ranks 1,6,6,1 (shapes (6,1),(7,6),(6,7),(1,6)) for L*=sum and two further generic L, and Ann dims 0,0,14,50,125 are consistent with b1,2=14. Betti table satisfies Gorenstein symmetry b_i(t)=b_{6-i}(10-t) and pd=6/reg=4 as required for codim-6 socle-4 Gorenstein. Apolarity catalecticant-rank method and Koszul homology rank-nullity are standard; commutativity checked. Result is computation-certified, honestly limited to one object with no general theorem claimed.

originality.rationale: Verified against live literature: 2206.02723 classifies only P4 two-base Perazzo 3-folds; 2402.09188 classifies P^{n+2} two-base family and explicitly states results do not generalize to P^{n+3} three-base family f=sum p_i(u,v,w)x_i+g(u,v,w); 2405.14756 gives max/min Hilbert vectors, proves max never has WLP and min holds under unimodality+mild condition, solves MFR only for 5-variable minimal case (Thm 5.4), and leaves intermediate vectors and n>=m>=3 WLP/MFR open (Sec.6 Problems 1-2). Named quartic F*=x0*u^3+x1*v^3+x2*(u+v)^3+w^4 (6 variables, n=2/m=3 Perazzo-type, outside n>=m hypothesis) and its Hilbert vector (1,6,7,6,1), Hessian certificate, WLP-HOLDS verdict with minors 2/4, and Betti table are in none of those papers and are not mechanically implied: formal max-formula would predict h2>=15 for general p_i, whereas special binomial p_i plus w^4 give 7. Monomial-CI classifications (Lundqvist-Nicklasson) concern disjoint objects/methods. No prior record of this F* was found; 2405.14756 HTML confirms the open-region status.

value.rationale: Headline is a rigorously established exact invariant set (Hilbert vector, vanishing-Hessian certificate, WLP verdict with explicit full-rank minors, graded Betti table) of a pre-motivated minimal natural object: the smallest degree-4 6-variable form with genuinely three-variable base dependence (p_i=u^3,v^3,(u+v)^3 dependent but independent, w via w^4) lying strictly outside the classified P^{n+2} two-base theorems in the expressly open P^{n+3} region. Value was not known or mechanically implied before computation; WLP HOLDS separates this point from the P^{n+2} 'max fails' behaviour, correcting the admitted guess of failure without losing novelty. A future researcher on vanishing-Hessian/Gorenstein-Lefschetz classification could reasonably need this precise first data point and certificate. This is an eligible narrow exact datum under the shared standard, not a textbook restatement, parameter substitution, tiny gain, or unexplained enumeration; no general criterion or completed census is demanded for this headline.

decisive_checks: Re-executed inputs/artifacts/verify_Fstar.py with sympy: Hilbert [1,6,7,6,1], Hessian det 0, ranks 6/6 with minors 2 and 4, all Betti rows plus Euler identities OK, VERIFY_OK.
Independently verified Hessian rank argument: displayed 6x6 Hessian shows x0/x1/x2 rows supported only in u,v columns (3 rows in 2-dim subspace), hence identically singular.

Independently recomputed multiplication ranks for L*=sum and two further linear forms ([1,2,3,5,7,11], [0,0,0,1,1,1]): all give maximal profile [1,6,6,1] = min(h_i,h_{i+1}); confirmed Ann dims 0,0,14,50,125 and Betti symmetry b1(2)=b5(8)=14, b2(3)=b4(7)=36.
Compared claim against max/min formulas: general max-formula would give h2>=15, so (1,6,7,6,1) is not mechanically implied; object has n=2<m=3, outside the n>=m hypothesis of the classified theorems.
residual_risks: Betti table rests on the Koszul-Tor rank-nullity implementation in the same script; Euler/Hilbert plus Gorenstein symmetry agreement for all t makes systematic error unlikely, but no second independent Koszul implementation was written.

Ann(F*) certified by dimension counts and Gorenstein symmetry, not by an exhibited minimal generating set; sufficient for Hilbert/WLP/Betti claims but a reader wanting generators must extract them from the script.
WLP certified by existence of one full-rank L* (plus spot generic checks), not a Zariski-open description; sufficient for WLP but leaves the full Lefschetz locus undetermined.
